text: At dawn, multiple explosions were reported near Meridian Port fuel depots and residents saw drones overhead.
Officials stated the operation targeted a military logistics warehouse, not civilian facilities.
Port operations slowed by 40 percent and insurers announced temporary premium surcharges.
Investigators said satellite imagery was partially obscured by cloud cover, so strike coordinates could not be independently verified.
Neighboring states called for restraint and announced an emergency diplomatic dialogue in the regional council.
